title: Server log metrics contain unfiltered anomalies
description: The infrastructure monitoring report shows CPU utilization values of -10% and 150%, which are clearly invalid. These need to be filtered before recalculating averages.

title: Multi-datacenter network traffic not normalized
description: Network throughput data from three datacenters is reported in different units (MB / GB / TB); normalization to a common unit is required before comparing datacenter loads.

title: Monthly system availability aggregation report missing
description: Per-service availability data has been collected; it needs to be aggregated by service type and a monthly SLA attainment report needs to be generated.

title: Datacenter air conditioning maintenance request
description: The air conditioning unit in Building B datacenter has failed and needs repair. Not related to data analysis.
